notes:
Quick CRM notes / call excerpts:
- Company: Lodestar Knowledgeworks — SaaS helpdesk KB + automated triage.
- Primary ask: hosted API for embeddings + a light cross-encoder reranker to improve top-10 precision. Wants simple managed stack (no infra ops).
- Scale: ~3M indexed docs (articles + ticket threads, avg 1.8KB), expected peak query load ~700 QPS (support peak hours), steady-state ~150 QPS.
- Retrieval strategy they prefer: dense retrieval (1536-d embeddings) + HNSW ANN for speed, then cross-encoder rerank for final ordering.
- Latency targets: p50 <50ms, p95 <120ms, p99 <200ms for end-to-end retrieval+rerank (hard SLA ask).
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Looking for cost projection per 1M queries; target around <$1,000 per 1M queries if possible (rough ask).
- Data needs: retention controls + audit logs; must support SSO/SAML and have clear data residency terms (EU customer subsets).
- Security: CISO insists on proof of SOC2 equivalent controls and ability to route logs to their SIEM. Quote from CISO: "we can't accept black-box retention — need explicit TTLs and exportable audit trails."
- POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
  * Recall@10 >= 0.78 on sample query-set (support-focused queries)
  * End-to-end p99 <= 200ms under synthetic 700 QPS test (or clear trade-off plan)
  * Cost estimate delivered for 3M docs, 700 QPS peak, monthly run-rate
- Tech questions from their infra: how KV cache + prefix caching interacts with many short queries; suggestions on continuous batching improvements requested.
- Competitive notes: already trialed Pinecone + lightweight reranker; lost some recall on long ticket threads. Evaluating Redwood for managed rerank + smarter batching.
- Next practical: Lodestar to share 100k-row sample + query set. We will run hosted API POC with optimize config suggestions (quantization+batching) and return: latency profile, token/unit cost, and recommended ANN params (efConstruction/efSearch, M).
- Sales/ops: Procurement expects legal review in parallel — budget signs by mid-Dec.
- Misc shorthand: "SE to build harness; send perf report by 11/18; follow legal w/ security FAQ link."
notes_summary: Evaluation POC: embeddings + ANN retrieval + cross-encoder rerank. 3M docs, 700 QPS peak, tight p99 SLA, data residency + audit logs are blockers. Want hosted API + optimize recommendations. SE assigned and POC checklist in drive.
